trial_court: District Judge, Family Court, Kalaburagi - M.C.No.261/2017
facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who solemnized their marriage on 21.06.2012. The husband filed a petition under Section 13 (1) (ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 which was dismissed by the trial court. This appeal is against that judgment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has treated them cruelly.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant divorce unless the petitioner proves that the respondent has treated them cruelly or deserted them continuously for more than two years.
legal_principles.held: The Family Court, which was considering questions such as whether the appellant proves that the respondent has treated him cruelly and whether she has deserted him continuously for a period of more than two years, has answered the questions in favour of the respondent dismissing the appellant's petition for divorce.

outcome.final_order: The marriage of the parties is dissolved in the interest of justice and equity.
